card.name: Linking words before animal terms
card.fires_on: Small linking words or punctuation (as, of, from, such, for, a quote mark) in texts about animals, zoos, pets, poultry or wildlife, where a word like animal or zoo may come next.

modes.label: Linking word in animal text
modes.description: A small word like as, kept, from, such or for in passages about wildlife trade, poultry or zoo animals.

modes.description: A quote mark or the word of right before an animal-related word such as wet market or Animals.

card.writes: It makes animal, zoo and their Chinese equivalents more likely as the next word.
card.plain: It fires on small connecting words in animal or zoo texts, when a word like animal is likely to come next.
